name: OBSERVATORY
summary: How your OpenRig machines are doing: each machine, its seats, its queues and its health, with where and when every reading was measured.

surface.hint: your machines: seats, queues and health, with the age of each reading

_note: Read only. The page asks the provider, the provider reads each machine's OpenRig daemon, and nothing is written anywhere. A machine that can't be read is shown with the reason, never as empty or healthy.
